service.safetyWarningDesc: A folyamat során: • A gyújtásnak BE kell lennie • A motornak KI kell állnia • Ne indítsa be a járművet Folytatja?
service.step1Desc: Az összes tárolt hibakód (DTC) és a Check Engine jelzőfény törlődik. Az üzemanyag-csökkentési értékek visszaállnak. Ez a művelet nem vonható vissza!
service.step2Desc: A rendszer egy elektromos visszaállítást (Hard Reset) küld a motorszámítógépnek. Úgy működik, mint az akkumulátor eltávolítása és behelyezése. ⚠️ Nem hatékony a nem támogató ECU-kban. Nem árt.

live.title: ÉLŐ MONITORING ÉRZÉKELŐK
live.content: Azonnal figyelheti a fordulatszámot, a sebességet, a motor hőmérsékletét, a fojtószelep helyzetét, az akkumulátorfeszültséget, a motorterhelést, a beszívott levegő hőmérsékletét és a szívócső nyomását (MAP). Az értékek másodpercenként 1-5 alkalommal frissülnek a Bluetooth sebességétől függően. A terminálon keresztül UDS / OBD parancsokkal közvetlenül beavatkozhat a járműbe.

expertise.title: VIZSGÁLAT ÉS GARANCIA
expertise.content: Az alkalmazás ECU (Brain) kódokat használ a hibák észlelésére. A rendszer rögzíti a járművön rögzített VIN-számot (VIN) és az aktuális futásteljesítményt. Ezenkívül a múltbeli hibákat úgy határozzák meg, hogy a Check Engine jelzőfényével kiszámítják, mennyit tett meg a jármű. Az eredményül kapott jelentés megosztható PDF és üzenetküldő környezetben.

tests.title: AKKUMULÁTOR / TELJESÍTMÉNY TESZTEK
tests.content: Az akkumulátorteszt 3 szakaszból áll: a nyugalmi, indítási és alapjárati töltési tesztek mérik az akkumulátor/szabályozó állapotát. A teljesítményteszt 0-60 és 0-100 km/h gyorsulási értékeket mér 50 ms-os hibahatárral, a telefon processzorának és járművének pillanatnyi sebességadatait felhasználva.

hardware.title: HARDVER KOMPATIBILITÁS
hardware.content: Az ELM327 Bluetooth (v1.5) használata javasolt. Előfordulhat, hogy egyes speciális kódok nem működnek gyenge minőségű hardveren a v2.1 CLONE verzióval. A leggyorsabb sebességet az olyan prémium adapterekkel érheti el, mint a vLinker és az OBDLink.

warnings.title: FONTOS FIGYELMEZTETÉSEK
warnings.content: • A gyújtásnak BE és a motornak KI kell lennie a hibakód törlési folyamata vagy az ECU-visszaállítás funkció alatt. • Ne küldjön visszaállítást futó járműre. • Előfordulhat, hogy nem minden jármű támogatja az összes érzékelőt, a nem támogatott érzékelőknél "--" jelenik meg.

onboarding.title: JOGI ENGEDÉLYEK ÉS ANONÍM TELEMETRIA
onboarding.content: Az alkalmazás minőségének és a járművek kompatibilitásának javítása érdekében; A teljesen anonimizált motorparaméterek és a hibadiagnosztika során generált hibakódok (személyes adatok és alvázszám nélkül) elemezhetők biztonságos szervereinken. A folytatással elfogadja ezeket az anonim telemetriai feltételeket. A motorkerékpár ECU-jával való kommunikációhoz Bluetooth és helymeghatározási engedélyek szükségesek.

featureCoding.title: HIDDEN FEATURE UNLOCK & UDS CODING
featureCoding.content: Powered by our ISO 14229 UDS Protocol Engine, safely toggle features like US Parking Lights, Needle Sweep, Horn Ack Lock, Comfort Windows, and DRL settings for VAG, BMW, Renault, and Dacia vehicles.

multiEcu.title: MULTI-ECU ALL MODULE SCANNING
multiEcu.content: Scan and clear fault codes beyond the Engine ECU — including ABS, Airbag, Automatic Transmission (TCU), Instrument Cluster, Climate Control (HVAC), and Body Control Modules (BCM).

advancedDiagnostics.title: DCT ADAPTATION, DPF & HP POWER GAUGE
advancedDiagnostics.content:
• DCT / DSG Clutch Kiss Point Learning & Adaptation Reset
• DPF Soot Load (%/g) & Exhaust Regeneration Temp Monitoring
• Real-time Short/Long Term Fuel Trims (STFT/LTFT) & Lambda Analysis
• Dynamic Horsepower (HP) & Torque (Nm) Live Telemetry Graph

demoMode.title: DEMO MODE (SIMULATION)
demoMode.content: Test and explore the app without physical OBD2 hardware. Experience full CAN-Bus and UDS diagnostic features with realistic real-time telemetry simulation.

freeze.title: FREEZE FRAME
freeze.desc: Beolvassa a motor paramétereit, amikor a Check Engine lámpa kigyullad. Ezek az adatok kritikus információkat nyújtanak a hibadiagnosztikában.

freeze.techDesc: • OBD-II mód 02: Képkocka adatok kimerevítése • PID 020C00: RPM hiba • PID 020D00: Hiba a sebességben • PID 020500: A hűtővíz hőmérséklete a hiba idején Ezek az adatok az utolsó hibakódhoz tartoznak. A hibakódok törlésekor a képkockák kimerevítése is törlődik.

Changing this feature directly affects your vehicle's factory settings and ECU software. Please read the following risks carefully:

• Incorrect application may void your vehicle warranty.
• Some changes may cause permanent faults or unexpected electrical errors.
• While the operation may be reversible, some ECU modules may require a factory reset.
• The user is solely responsible for any material or immaterial damage resulting from the use of this feature.
• Cortex OBD2 Diagnostic Scanner cannot be held responsible for any malfunction or damage caused by these changes.

You must confirm that you have read and understood this warning.
hiddenFeatures.check1: I have read this warning and understand that my vehicle warranty may be affected.
hiddenFeatures.check2: I acknowledge that Cortex OBD2 Diagnostic Scanner is not responsible for any faults or damages resulting from this operation.
hiddenFeatures.check3: I wish to make this change knowingly and of my own free will, accepting all risks.
hiddenFeatures.unsupportedMsg:
The connected OBD2 device does not yet support this feature.

A compatible ELM327 v2.1+ adapter is required for hidden feature writing. Clone or standard adapters cannot process these commands.

vag_staging_needle_sweep.name: Gauge Staging / Needle Sweep

vag_acoustic_lock_confirmation.name: Acoustic Lock Confirmation Chirp

vag_american_parking_lights.name: US Style Parking Lights

vag_drl_menu_toggle.name: Daytime Running Lights (DRL) Menu Toggle
vag_drl_menu_toggle.desc: Enables DRL ON/OFF checkbox in infotainment vehicle settings menu.

vag_tear_wiping.name: Windshield Tear Wiping
vag_tear_wiping.desc: Executes an additional final wipe 5 seconds after windshield washer use.

vag_emergency_brake_flashing.name: Emergency Brake Hazard Flashing
vag_emergency_brake_flashing.desc: Rapidly flashes brake lights and hazards under heavy emergency braking.

vag_cornering_lights.name: Cornering Fog Lights
vag_cornering_lights.desc: Illuminates cornering fog light on steering wheel rotation side.

vag_comfort_mirror_folding.name: Key Fob Comfort Mirror Folding
vag_comfort_mirror_folding.desc: Automatically folds side mirrors when lock button is held on key fob.

vag_lap_timer.name: Instrument Cluster Lap Timer
vag_lap_timer.desc: Unlocks track lap timer display tab in instrument cluster screen.

vag_refuel_quantity.name: Refuel Quantity Display

bmw_start_stop_memory.name: Auto Start-Stop Memory Mode
bmw_start_stop_memory.desc: Remembers last Auto Start-Stop state (OFF/ON) across vehicle restarts.

bmw_digital_speedometer.name: Digital Speedometer Display
bmw_digital_speedometer.desc: Adds instant digital speed numerical display option to cluster screen.

bmw_sport_displays.name: Sport Displays (HP & Nm Gauges)
bmw_sport_displays.desc: Enables live horsepower and torque dynamic dials in iDrive screen.

bmw_acoustic_lock_sound.name: Acoustic Lock/Unlock Sound
bmw_acoustic_lock_sound.desc: Emits alarm system chirps when locking or unlocking the vehicle.

bmw_mirror_fold_delay_zero.name: Instant Mirror Folding (0.0s Delay)
bmw_mirror_fold_delay_zero.desc: Folds side mirrors instantly upon lock button press without holding delay.

bmw_tpms_tire_temperature.name: Tire Pressure & Temperature Display
bmw_tpms_tire_temperature.desc: Displays real-time tire temperature alongside pressure in TPMS screen.

renault_trip_computer_enable.name: On-Board Trip Computer Enable
renault_trip_computer_enable.desc: Unlocks average fuel consumption and range trip computer displays.

renault_external_temp_display.name: External Temperature Display
renault_external_temp_display.desc: Enables ambient outdoor temperature reading in instrument cluster.

renault_automatic_tailgate.name: Key Fob Trunk Release
renault_automatic_tailgate.desc: Fully pops trunk latch mechanism upon holding key fob trunk button.

renault_alarm_chirp.name: Alarm Lock Confirmation Chirp
renault_alarm_chirp.desc: Sounds horn confirmation chirp upon vehicle door locking.

renault_shift_indicator.name: Gear Shift Indicator (GSI)
renault_shift_indicator.desc: Activates eco-driving shift UP/DOWN arrows in instrument cluster.

ford_double_horn_honk_disable.name: Disable Double Horn Honk on Door Close
ford_double_horn_honk_disable.desc: Disables double horn honk when closing door with engine running.

ford_auto_door_locking.name: Auto Door Locking at 20 km/h
ford_auto_door_locking.desc: Automatically locks all doors when vehicle speed exceeds 20 km/h.

ford_tpms_psi_display.name: Numerical Tire Pressure Display
ford_tpms_psi_display.desc: Displays exact numerical PSI/BAR pressure per tire in instrument screen.

ford_sync_climate_screen.name: SYNC Screen Climate Controls
ford_sync_climate_screen.desc: Adds climate control and seat heating touchscreen menu to SYNC display.

stellantis_power_windows_remote.name: Key Fob Remote Window Roll Up/Down
stellantis_power_windows_remote.desc: Rolls up or down all power windows when holding lock/unlock buttons.

stellantis_cornering_fogs.name: Cornering Fog Lights Enable
stellantis_cornering_fogs.desc: Illuminates cornering fog lamp during low-speed turns.

vag_traffic_sign_recognition.name: Traffic Sign Recognition (VZE)
vag_traffic_sign_recognition.desc: Displays camera-detected speed signs in instrument cluster and HUD.

vag_ambient_color_palette_30.name: 30-Color Ambient Lighting Palette
vag_ambient_color_palette_30.desc: Unlocks 30 RGB interior lighting color picker in MIB infotainment menu.

vag_seatbelt_warning_mute.name: Seatbelt Chime Deactivation
vag_seatbelt_warning_mute.desc: Disables unbuckled seatbelt acoustic chime in instrument cluster.

bmw_alpina_cluster_theme.name: Alpina Digital Dash Layout
bmw_alpina_cluster_theme.desc: Applies blue Alpina signature theme to digital instrument cluster.

bmw_video_in_motion.name: Video In Motion (VIM)
bmw_video_in_motion.desc: Unlocks USB video playback on iDrive screen while driving.

bmw_sport_plus_mode_unlock.name: Sport+ Driving Mode Enable
bmw_sport_plus_mode_unlock.desc: Enables Sport+ high-performance dynamic driving mode in DEC selector.

mercedes_amg_menu_unlock.name: AMG Performance Telemetry Menu
mercedes_amg_menu_unlock.desc: Displays AMG oil temp, transmission temp, lap timer, and G-meter.

mercedes_agility_mode_enable.name: Agility (A) Transmission Mode
mercedes_agility_mode_enable.desc: Unlocks ultra-responsive Agility shift program in 7G/9G-Tronic transmission.

mercedes_drl_brightness_boost.name: Daytime Running Lights 100% Intensity
mercedes_drl_brightness_boost.desc: Increases LED daytime running lights output to 100% full brightness.

mercedes_alarm_lock_chirp.name: Acoustic Locking Horn Chirp
mercedes_alarm_lock_chirp.desc: Emits short horn chirp notification when central locking is engaged.

mercedes_dpf_adblue_gauge.name: DPF Soot & AdBlue Level Gauge
mercedes_dpf_adblue_gauge.desc: Displays exact DPF soot mass percentage and remaining AdBlue range in IC.

renault_rs_monitor_enable.name: Renault Sport RS Monitor Telemetry
renault_rs_monitor_enable.desc: Enables live G-force, turbo boost, and oil temp telemetry on R-Link.

renault_duster_mirror_fold.name: Duster Auto Mirror Folding on Lock
renault_duster_mirror_fold.desc: Folds side mirrors automatically via BCM central locking command.

ford_bambi_mode_fog_light.name: Bambi Mode (High Beams + Fog Lights)
ford_bambi_mode_fog_light.desc: Allows fog lights to remain ON when high beam headlights are activated.

ford_st_rs_boot_animation.name: ST/RS Performance SYNC Boot Screen
ford_st_rs_boot_animation.desc: Changes SYNC touchscreen startup splash animation to ST / RS logo.

toyota_reverse_beep_mute.name: Reverse Gear Continuous Cabin Beep Mute
toyota_reverse_beep_mute.desc: Mutes continuous reverse gear chime inside cabin to a single beep.

toyota_remote_window_drop.name: Key Fob Remote Window Roll Down
toyota_remote_window_drop.desc: Rolls down all power windows when holding key fob unlock button.

toyota_auto_lock_shift_p.name: Auto Lock Doors on Gear Shift (P -> D)
toyota_auto_lock_shift_p.desc: Automatically locks all doors when shifting out of Park position.

peugeot_icockpit_theme_unlock.name: Peugeot 3D i-Cockpit Performance Theme
peugeot_icockpit_theme_unlock.desc: Unlocks Copper and Track Red color display themes on 3D digital cluster.

jeep_offroad_pages_enable.name: Jeep Uconnect Off-Road Pages
jeep_offroad_pages_enable.desc: Enables pitch/roll angle gauges, wheel articulation, and 4x4 lock status.

hyundai_smart_welcome_mirror.name: Smart Key Approach Welcome Mirror Unfold
hyundai_smart_welcome_mirror.desc: Automatically unfolds side mirrors when approaching vehicle with smart key.

hyundai_one_touch_turn_7_flashes.name: One-Touch Lane Change Signal (7 Flashes)
hyundai_one_touch_turn_7_flashes.desc: Sets one-touch lane change blinker duration to 7 flashes.

hyundai_svm_camera_speed_extend.name: 360° Surround Camera Speed Extension (20 km/h)
hyundai_svm_camera_speed_extend.desc: Keeps 360-degree parking camera active up to 20 km/h forward speed.

hyundai_n_performance_exhaust_flap.name: N-Performance Exhaust Flap Default OPEN
hyundai_n_performance_exhaust_flap.desc: Sets active exhaust valve default position to OPEN on engine start.

vag_rain_closing_sunroof.name: Rain Closing (Regenschließen)
vag_rain_closing_sunroof.desc: Automatically closes sunroof and windows when rain is detected while parked.

bmw_launch_control_unlock.name: Launch Control Unlock
bmw_launch_control_unlock.desc: Unlocks factory launch control acceleration program in transmission ECU.

mercedes_ambient_64_multi_zone.name: 64-Color Multi-Zone Ambient Profile
mercedes_ambient_64_multi_zone.desc: Unlocks dynamic multi-zone color cycle animation in MBUX interior lighting.

ford_trailer_brake_activation.name: Trailer Brake Controller (TBC) Enable
ford_trailer_brake_activation.desc: Enables integrated trailer brake controller menu in instrument cluster.

gm_afm_dfm_cylinder_deactivation_disable.name: AFM/DFM V8 Cylinder Lock (No V4 Drop)
gm_afm_dfm_cylinder_deactivation_disable.desc: Locks engine in 8-cylinder mode permanently to prevent V4 vibration.

gm_remote_start_time_extend.name: Remote Start Duration Extension (20 Mins)
gm_remote_start_time_extend.desc: Extends factory key fob remote engine start run time from 10 to 20 minutes.

dodge_srt_performance_pages.name: SRT Performance Pages & Drive Modes
dodge_srt_performance_pages.desc: Unlocks Uconnect 0-100 acceleration timers, G-force meter, and launch control.

ram_bambi_mode_fog.name: RAM Truck Fog Lights with High Beam
ram_bambi_mode_fog.desc: Allows RAM fog lights to remain active alongside high beam headlights.

byd_avas_pedestrian_siren_mute.name: AVAS EV Low-Speed Siren Mute
byd_avas_pedestrian_siren_mute.desc: Mutes low-speed artificial electric motor siren below 30 km/h.

chery_isa_overspeed_chime_mute.name: ISA Overspeed Warning Chime Deactivation
chery_isa_overspeed_chime_mute.desc: Disables continuous 80/120 km/h overspeed warning beep on Tiggo/MG models.

mg_ev_battery_preconditioning_toggle.name: EV Fast-Charge Battery Pre-Heating Manual Switch
mg_ev_battery_preconditioning_toggle.desc: Enables manual battery pre-heating switch before DC fast charging.

chery_dms_fatigue_camera_mute.name: Driver Monitoring (DMS) Camera Sensitivity Reduction
chery_dms_fatigue_camera_mute.desc: Reduces over-sensitive eye-tracking fatigue warnings on steering column.

honda_walk_away_auto_lock.name: Walk-Away Auto Door Lock
honda_walk_away_auto_lock.desc: Automatically locks all doors when driver steps 2 meters away with key fob.

subaru_avh_auto_hold_memory.name: Auto Vehicle Hold (AVH) Memory Mode
subaru_avh_auto_hold_memory.desc: Remembers AVH brake hold ON/OFF state across ignition cycles.

volvo_start_stop_default_off.name: Auto Start-Stop Default OFF Mode
volvo_start_stop_default_off.desc: Sets Start-Stop engine shutoff system default state to OFF upon vehicle start.

volvo_polestar_digital_theme.name: Polestar Blue Digital Cluster Theme
volvo_polestar_digital_theme.desc: Unlocks Polestar signature blue dynamic gauge theme in Volvo driver display.

vag_virtual_cockpit_r_theme.name: Virtual Cockpit R / S / Cupra Performance Themes
vag_virtual_cockpit_r_theme.desc: Unlocks R-Line, S-Line, and Cupra central tachometer performance themes in digital cockpit.

vag_sound_symposer_mute.name: Sound Symposer Fake Engine Noise Deactivation
vag_sound_symposer_mute.desc: Deactivates cabin speaker fake engine sound generator for pure exhaust note.

vag_wireless_carplay_enable.name: Wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Activation
vag_wireless_carplay_enable.desc: Enables 5GHz Wi-Fi wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on MIB2.5/MIB3 units.

vag_offroad_telemetry_menu.name: MIB Offroad Telemetry & Gauge Display
vag_offroad_telemetry_menu.desc: Displays steering angle, oil temp, coolant temp, and altitude gauges on MIB screen.

vag_easy_entry_driver_seat.name: Automatic Easy Entry Power Seat Back-step
vag_easy_entry_driver_seat.desc: Moves electric driver seat back 5 cm upon door opening for easy vehicle entry.

vag_hba_memory_state.name: High-Beam Assist (HBA) Memory Retention
vag_hba_memory_state.desc: Remembers High-Beam Assist ON status across ignition restart cycles.

vag_battery_soc_display.name: Battery State of Charge (% SOC) Display
vag_battery_soc_display.desc: Shows exact battery charge percentage (% SOC) on instrument cluster when trip button is held.

bmw_idrive7_m_animation.name: iDrive 7 / 8 M-Performance Startup Animation
bmw_idrive7_m_animation.desc: Changes iDrive screen boot graphic to M-Performance or M-GmbH logo animation.

bmw_bowers_wilkins_audio_profiles.name: Bowers & Wilkins 3D Sound Engine Unlock
bmw_bowers_wilkins_audio_profiles.desc: Unlocks Bowers & Wilkins Concert, Studio, and Stage DSP audio profiles on HiFi systems.

bmw_hitch_zoom_camera.name: Reverse Camera Trailer Hitch Zoom Mode
bmw_hitch_zoom_camera.desc: Unlocks top-down trailer hitch alignment zoom mode on reverse camera view.

bmw_secure_idle_protection.name: Secure Idle Engine Shift-Lock Protection
bmw_secure_idle_protection.desc: Locks transmission in Park if driver leaves running vehicle with key fob.

bmw_seatbelt_handover_mute.name: Coupe Electric Seatbelt Handover Arm Deactivation
bmw_seatbelt_handover_mute.desc: Disables motorized seatbelt extender arm on 4 Series and 2 Series Coupes.

bmw_auto_heat_threshold_5c.name: Automatic Seat & Steering Wheel Heating Temperature (+5°C)
bmw_auto_heat_threshold_5c.desc: Triggers automatic seat and steering wheel heating when ambient temp drops below 5°C.

mercedes_amg_track_pace_unlock.name: MBUX AMG Track Pace Telemetry & Lap Timer
mercedes_amg_track_pace_unlock.desc: Unlocks lap timing, acceleration telemetry, and G-force graphs on MBUX screen.

mercedes_drive_mode_last_memory.name: Dynamic Select Last Drive Mode Memory
mercedes_drive_mode_last_memory.desc: Remembers last selected Drive Mode (Individual / Sport) across vehicle restart.

mercedes_proximity_360_camera_auto.name: Proximity Sensor Auto 360° Camera View
mercedes_proximity_360_camera_auto.desc: Automatically switches screen to 360 camera when front sensors detect obstacle < 50 cm.

ford_sync_climate_screen_unlock.name: SYNC3 / SYNC4 Touchscreen Climate Control Page
ford_sync_climate_screen_unlock.desc: Enables climate control, heated seat, and airflow direction touchscreen page.

ford_turn_signal_5_flashes.name: One-Touch Lane Change Signal (5 Flashes)
ford_turn_signal_5_flashes.desc: Increases one-touch lane change turn signal duration from 3 to 5 flashes.

ford_auto_engine_shutdown_disable.name: 30-Minute Idle Auto Engine Shutdown Override
ford_auto_engine_shutdown_disable.desc: Prevents automatic engine shutoff after 30 minutes idle (for camping/power outlet use).

ev_battery_preheat_manual_switch.name: EV Battery Pre-Heating Manual Switch (Fast DC Charge Prep)
ev_battery_preheat_manual_switch.desc: Allows manual battery pre-heating to 25°C before DC fast charging without navigation route.

ev_v2l_power_output_expand.name: V2L (Vehicle-to-Load) 220V Outlet Power Expansion (3.6 kW)
ev_v2l_power_output_expand.desc: Expands V2L external 220V AC household power outlet limit from 2.2 kW to 3.6 kW.

ev_one_pedal_regen_force_level3.name: One-Pedal Drive Maximum Regenerative Braking Default
ev_one_pedal_regen_force_level3.desc: Sets maximum regenerative braking (One-Pedal stop mode) as default on vehicle start.

byd_soc_max_charge_target_limit.name: BYD Battery Health Protection Max Charge Limit (80% / 90%)
byd_soc_max_charge_target_limit.desc: Sets max AC/DC charge cutoff limit to 80% or 90% to extend Blade Battery lifespan.

byd_dmi_forced_pure_ev_speed_override.name: BYD DM-i Pure EV Mode Gasoline Engine Override
byd_dmi_forced_pure_ev_speed_override.desc: Inhibits gasoline engine start in EV mode up to 130 km/h even during full throttle acceleration.

byd_vtol_v2v_rescue_charge_mode.name: BYD VTOL (Vehicle-to-Vehicle) Rescue Charge Mode
byd_vtol_v2v_rescue_charge_mode.desc: Unlocks external AC power output to charge stranded electric vehicles on road.

hyundai_ipedal_memory_lock.name: Hyundai / Kia i-PEDAL One-Pedal Drive Memory Lock
hyundai_ipedal_memory_lock.desc: Prevents i-PEDAL one-pedal stop mode from dropping back to Level 3 after shifting to Reverse.

hyundai_utility_mode_12v_saver.name: Utility Camping Mode High-Voltage 12V Saver
hyundai_utility_mode_12v_saver.desc: Powers 220V V2L outlet directly from HV traction battery to prevent auxiliary 12V battery drain.

hyundai_phev_no_ice_climate_start.name: PHEV EV Mode Climate Heating Gasoline Engine Suppression
hyundai_phev_no_ice_climate_start.desc: Forces heat pump / PTC electric heater for cabin climate without starting gasoline engine.

vag_taycan_ess_sound_profile_swap.name: Electric Sport Sound (ESS) Taycan / RS e-tron Profile
vag_taycan_ess_sound_profile_swap.desc: Changes electric driving sound profile to Porsche Taycan GTS or Audi RS e-tron GT sound generator.

vag_meb_daily_charge_target_menu.name: MEB Battery Daily 80% / Trip 100% Quick Charge Bar
vag_meb_daily_charge_target_menu.desc: Adds quick toggle bar on MIB screen to switch between 80% daily battery care and 100% trip charge.

vag_gte_generator_charge_reserve.name: GTE / E-Mode Engine Generator Battery Force Charge (80%)
vag_gte_generator_charge_reserve.desc: Forces combustion engine to act as generator to recharge high-voltage battery up to 80% while driving.

bmw_hans_zimmer_iconic_sounds_m.name: Hans Zimmer IconicSounds Electric M-Performance Sound Engine
bmw_hans_zimmer_iconic_sounds_m.desc: Unlocks Hans Zimmer acoustic M-Performance electric acceleration sound profiles on i4 and iX.

bmw_phev_max_edrive_140kmh.name: PHEV MAX eDrive Pure Electric Speed Ceiling (140 km/h)
bmw_phev_max_edrive_140kmh.desc: Increases max pure electric speed ceiling on 330e / 530e Plug-in hybrids to 140 km/h.

bmw_ac_charging_current_limit_menu.name: AC Home Charger Maximum Current Limit Selector (6A - 32A)
bmw_ac_charging_current_limit_menu.desc: Adds AC home charging current limiter (6A / 10A / 16A / 32A) to prevent home circuit overload.

toyota_hybrid_ev_mode_override.name: Toyota / Lexus EV Mode Throttle Override Suppression
toyota_hybrid_ev_mode_override.desc: Prevents gasoline engine from forced start during acceleration when EV mode button is active.

toyota_hybrid_battery_fan_speed_boost.name: Toyota / Lexus High-Voltage Battery Cooling Fan Boost (+30%)
toyota_hybrid_battery_fan_speed_boost.desc: Increases hybrid traction battery cooling fan speed by +30% to prevent thermal degradation in hot climates.

tesla_sentry_high_bitrate_video.name: Tesla Sentry Mode High-Bitrate Continuous Dashcam Recording
tesla_sentry_high_bitrate_video.desc: Increases Sentry Mode camera video recording bitrate for crystal-clear license plate visibility.

tesla_cabin_overheat_threshold_30c.name: Tesla Cabin Overheat Protection Temperature Threshold (30°C)
tesla_cabin_overheat_threshold_30c.desc: Lowers cabin overheat protection climate trigger temperature from 40°C to 30°C for interior preservation.

fuelTrim.title: FUEL TRIM & AIR-FUEL MIXTURE ANALYSIS
fuelTrim.subtitle: STFT (Short Term) & LTFT (Long Term) Diagnostics
fuelTrim.guideDesc: Rich mixture indicates excess fuel in combustion chamber (fuel waste, soot), while Lean mixture indicates excess air (high combustion temp, knock risk).
fuelTrim.causeNormal: System operates within ideal range (-5% to +5%). No faults.
fuelTrim.causeVacuumLeak: Vacuum leaks, torn hoses, or intake manifold gasket
fuelTrim.causeDirtyMaf: Dirty or faulty MAF (Mass Air Flow) sensor
fuelTrim.causeLowFuelPressure: Low fuel pump pressure or clogged fuel filter
fuelTrim.actionCriticalLean: Perform smoke test for intake leaks and clean MAF sensor.
fuelTrim.causeMinorVacuumLeak: Minor air leak or aging O2 sensor
fuelTrim.actionMildLean: Check live O2 sensor data and intake hoses.
fuelTrim.actionCriticalRich: Inspect EVAP purge valve and injector return leak-off.
fuelTrim.actionMildRich: Check or replace engine air filter.

dpf.title: DIESEL PARTICULATE FILTER (DPF) MONITOR
dpf.subtitle: Soot & Ash Mass, Exhaust Gas Temp & Regeneration Status
dpf.recommendNormal: Filter state is optimal. Continue normal driving.
dpf.recommendHighwayDrive: Drive on highway for 20 mins at 2000-2500 RPM (Passive Regen).
dpf.recommendServiceRegen: Filter clogged! Service regeneration or cleaning required.

aiDoctor.analyzing: Analyzing DTC codes & engine telemetry with AI Doctor...
aiDoctor.noFaultsTitle: System Optimal — No Fault Codes Detected
aiDoctor.noFaultsSummary: ECU telemetry shows no active diagnostic trouble codes. Engine parameters are within normal operating thresholds.
aiDoctor.stepMaintain: Maintain regular oil and filter service intervals.
aiDoctor.misfireSummary: Active misfire detected in one or more cylinders. Unburnt fuel may enter catalytic converter causing permanent damage.
aiDoctor.stepSwapCoils: Swap ignition coils between cylinders to test for fault transfer.
aiDoctor.criticalDrive: Do not drive extended distances under heavy throttle. Drive immediately to service.
aiDoctor.o2Summary: Air-fuel mixture feedback is degraded. Engine may run rich or lean, reducing fuel efficiency.
aiDoctor.causeExhaustLeak: Exhaust manifold leak upstream of sensor
aiDoctor.stepCheckWiring: Inspect O2 sensor wiring harness for melting or fraying.
aiDoctor.stepCleanSensor: Clean O2 sensor tip or replace sensor if resistance out of spec.
aiDoctor.warningDrive: Safe to drive to repair shop at moderate speed.
aiDoctor.genericSummary: Active trouble code(s) detected: {{codes}}. System monitoring recommended.
aiDoctor.causeGeneric1: Sensor circuit out of expected voltage range
aiDoctor.causeGeneric2: Loose electrical connection or ground fault
aiDoctor.stepGeneric1: Perform diagnostic scan and record freeze frame data.
aiDoctor.stepGeneric2: Clear DTC codes after inspecting harness connectors.

dtcRisk.warningDesc: Teljesítménycsökkenés és magasabb károsanyag-kibocsátás fordulhat elő. Mielőbb keresse fel a szervizt.
dtcRisk.criticalTitle: 🔴 KRITIKUS: ÁLLÍTSA LE A JÁRMŰVET / SZERVIZ
dtcRisk.criticalDesc: Kritikus mechanikai vagy elektromos kockázat! A motor vagy a biztonsági rendszerek megsérülhetnek. Azonnal álljon félre.

dtcDetail.cause2: Mechanical wear or electrical fault in component
dtcDetail.cause3: Perform voltage/resistance test with multimeter or replace component
